{{Otheruses|Gort}}
'''Gort's''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] restaurant in the [[Yaam Sector|Blackpit Slums]] that served [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] from [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Dac]], and had a [[sulyet]] bar where sulyet was served fresh. Some of the cuisine served was tikit grain, grain ball with a nudibranch, grain wine, and nexufish. Located on the fiftieth level, Gort's featured [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Music/Legends|music]], which was mostly [[Wikipedia:Atonality|atonal]] [[quetarra]] [[Wikipedia:Étude|études]], and had a varied clientele.
